svg.title: StudyFlow AI container diagram
svg.desc: C4 container diagram. A user works in the React single-page app in their browser. Caddy serves the app over HTTPS and forwards API calls to an nginx gateway, which routes /auth to the Spring Boot auth service and /api/v1 to the FastAPI study service. The study service calls the FastAPI AI service with an internal key. Each service has its own PostgreSQL database; files sit on a shared uploads volume; the AI service keeps a FAISS index per group and calls the Groq API. The auth service sends password reset email over SMTP.

g.text: C4 level 2: what runs where, and how the parts talk to each other.
1. The browser loads the app from Caddy over HTTPS.
2. API calls carry an HttpOnly JWT cookie to the gateway.
3. nginx routes each call and applies rate limits.
4. AI work goes study service, then AI service, then Groq.
• Prompt-injection check and PII masking before the model.
• Retrieval scoped to the asking user's group.
• Answers and minutes keep only grounded claims.
• Service-to-service calls need the X-Internal-Key header.
One VM · Docker Compose · images from GHCR
Call, labelled with what it does and [protocol]
Every service owns its database. Internal calls stay inside the Docker network; only Caddy is exposed to the internet.
